title: We Rebuilt 90s Road Rash in Vanilla JavaScript
hookText: Wait... is that Road Rash in a browser tab?! 🏍️💥

scenes.visual: Close-up capture of bike rider pulling up next to a rival at 140 MPH, winding up a punch, and SMACKING them directly into an oncoming semi-truck. Screen shake + loud crunch SFX.
scenes.voiceover: Remember when motorcycle games let you literally punch people off their bikes?
scenes.onScreenText: 90s Road Rash is back... in pure JavaScript 💀

scenes.visual: High-speed pseudo-3D raster road rendering, bike cresting a steep elevation drop, dodging two oncoming yellow sedans by inches, tires smoking on a hairpin turn.
scenes.voiceover: We rebuilt that chaotic 90s retro brawler physics engine using zero external libraries.

scenes.visual: Player picks up a roadside club, pulls alongside two aggressive AI riders box-swarming, clubs the left rider (sending bike cartwheeling), kicks the right rider into a guardrail.
scenes.voiceover: No ads. No $70 price tag. Just 5 ruthless AI riders, elevation drops, and melee combat.
scenes.onScreenText: Pin the throttle. Throw the punch.

scenes.visual: Final corner before the finish line. Rival takes 1st place, player boosts with nitro draft, lands a flying right hook at the line to take 1st as the checkered flag waves.
scenes.voiceover: Steal 1st place in the final millisecond.

scenes.visual: Quick zoom out to show it running seamlessly in mobile Safari / Chrome browser, instant restart tap.
scenes.voiceover: Play Road Rumble right now in your browser at Kreeda.games. Zero install, completely free.

caption: We rebuilt classic 90s Road Rash arcade brawling in a single lightweight web file. Zero downloads, zero ads, pure nostalgic road rage. 🏍️💨 Play instant at kreeda.games
